description: Use when someone asks whether their own product's sitemaps were read by Google, or how many of their pages are indexed from them. The sitemaps submitted in the product's connected Search Console (or site, another property of the same site) with submitted and indexed counts, errors and warnings; pass url for one sitemap's detail. Read-only: it cannot submit a sitemap. No cost to call.

site.description: Another Search Console property for the product's own site, as Search Console lists it (sc-domain:example.com or https://www.example.com/), when the connected Google account can open it. Omit for the product's connected property.

url.description: One sitemap's full URL, for its detail. Omit to list every sitemap.

name: get_sitemaps
title: Sitemaps
